project_title: You will get WordPress Developer, WordPress Website, WordPress Designer, Website Design
question: Using the full pre-task conversation, identify the historical requirements and message evidence that are relevant to the current client task. Exclude unrelated history and do not treat the current task itself as historical evidence.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text:
The homepage looks great, and I also like the current gallery design. For the services page, could each listed service have a corresponding image—for example, photos, twilights, floor plans, and 3D views? Because this is primarily a photography business, every page should be highly visual and image-focused.

Please remove the monthly and annual tabs from the services page because all pricing is one-time only. For the bundles, could we have four spaces instead of 3? I would also like a large diagram showing every individual service we offer. Full pricing transparency is important so customers can see the exact breakdown and add individual items when needed. I have attached a PDF containing all items that must be included; most are categorized by both price and property square footage.

The main gallery only needs tabs for photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3d tour. A smaller area could cover other photography since we sometimes accept one-off clients. During development of the actual website, could the gallery items also receive hover animations? Overall, the pages look excellent!

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
Hope you're doing well, Priya.

Within the purchased package, please submit the requirements covering **branding**, the **content**, and **website details**.

I look forward to your response.

Thank you.

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
Priya,

To avoid the project being canceled automatically within a few hours, could you please submit the outstanding project requirements soon? We are looking forward to getting started once they arrive.

Best,
Elias

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Apologies for taking so long to respond; I was away from my computer for a while. I believe the initial details have now been sent, and I look forward to working with you!

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text: Now that the project requirements have been submitted, thank you. Could you also provide either a website that inspires you or a draft you have already begun working on?

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text: Before we can proceed, we need to determine whether you want any back-end functionality included in the website and, if so, what functionality you require.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: At this point, I already have a couple of pages of inspiration available. I will keep sending additional inspiration as I find it.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Specifically, what does back-end functionality mean in this context?

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text: Beyond the booking functionality already being considered, would you like the website to include any additional features, such as a membership portal or something similar?

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text: Yes—please send over some websites that can serve as design inspiration.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: One feature I have been considering is an instant quote calculator. Clients could complete a form or quiz that asks which services they want, and their answers would be used to calculate an estimated price in real time. It seems somewhat complicated from what I have researched, so is this something you would be able to build?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: As another possible back-end feature, could we have an interactive gallery that viewers are able to scroll through?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Here's an example with an interactive gallery.

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
A backend feature operates behind the visible parts of a website or app and supports communication with a database or other platforms. For instance, backend processes handle tasks such as logging in, saving information, placing orders, and receiving notifications.

An instant quote calculator is technically possible. However, I cannot yet determine its complexity, whether it fits within the current project scope, or whether it may involve an additional cost. Please share further details about the calculator and the logic it should use so I can assess it and guide you properly.

I can also add an eye-catching Gallery feature to the website.

Thank you!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Thanks so much for explaining. All of our services are itemized, and customers can qualify for a bundle as they select more services. The calculator would therefore need to recognize whether their selections meet the rules for a bundle; if they do not, it should simply add the individual service prices together. I picture it as a survey, potentially beginning like this:

Photos (yes/no)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Thank you for the clarification. Because all our services are itemized, selecting more of them can qualify a customer for a bundle. The calculator must determine whether the chosen services meet a bundle rule; otherwise, it should add the individual prices. I imagine a survey along these lines:

How many sqft is the property?
- under 1200: pricing tier 1
- 1201 - 2400: pricing tier 2
- 2401 - 3600: pricing tier 3
- 2401 - 3600: pricing tier 4
- 3601 +: pricing tier 5
(*An answer of 1840 sqft is assigned to pricing tier 2*)

Photos (yes/no): Yes = +320; No = +0.00 (*answers yes*)
Videos? (yes/no): Yes = +280; No = +0.00 (*answers yes*)
What is the address? The calculator determines the distance from the home office. If it is over 35 miles, apply a $90 surcharge. (*The submitted address is 42 miles away: +90*)
(*The selections qualify for the basic bundle: -$140*)
(*Presses submit*)
*Displays total: $550*

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Is it possible to support calculator variables like these?

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
The workflow you described can definitely be developed, but the required calculator is not available out of the box in WordPress. Although plugins exist, none satisfy these requirements. Custom development is necessary to support the pricing logic, bundle rules, square-footage tiers, distance calculations, and dynamic quote generation.

Because this work would require approximately 32-40 hours of custom development, I can provide it for an additional USD 540.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Thank you!

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
Priya,

For your review, we have prepared two initial homepage design concepts. Please examine them and tell us which direction you prefer. Before proceeding with the rest of the website, we will be happy to incorporate any changes or enhancements you request.

**Option 1**
<https://design.silverpine-media.example/proto/H7k2Lm9Qv4R8sT3Nx6Wp1Z/Silver-Pine-Media---Website-Concept?node-id=24-18&page-id=4%3A2>

**Option 2**

Thank you!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The work looks great so far, and Option 2 is closer to the direction we want. Since we have 4 bundles, could the pricing section contain 4 boxes? On the home screen, please reduce the amount of blue so the image receives more emphasis, while still retaining a little blue. Could you also give the homepage gallery some basic animation? Finally, please add a button or section in the pricing area that leads visitors to more detailed pricing information. Thank you!

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
Priya,

We appreciate the feedback and your selection of a preferred option. The requested changes are now being implemented, and we will send you an update in a few hours.

Best regards,
Team Brightforge Labs

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks so much. For now, I would like to defer the instant quote form. When the time is right to develop it, I will reach out again.

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text: Whenever you are ready to resume that feature, we will be available and happy to help. 🙂

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
The requested changes are now complete, and an updated interactive website design is ready for review in Figma. Please use the link below, look it over, and share any additional feedback.

<https://design.silverpine-media.example/proto/H7k2Lm9Qv4R8sT3Nx6Wp1Z/Silver-Pine-Media---Website-Concept?node-id=72-216&page-id=4%3A1&starting-point-node-id=72%3A216>

Thank you!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The homepage looks good overall. The only remaining change is to restore the home-screen image overlay to blue while reducing its opacity, leaving just a small blue highlight over the image. Once that is done, the homepage should be ready.

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
Priya,

We have noted the overlay feedback and will restore the blue while lowering its opacity so that it creates only a subtle highlight over the image. After making that change, I will share the revised homepage immediately for a final check, and we will then proceed with designing the next page.

Best regards,
Team Brightforge Labs

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thank you!

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text: You're welcome!

messages.speaker: agency
messages.text:
Priya,

Along with updating the homepage, we have now completed the designs for all remaining pages. The full updated Figma prototype is available below; please review every page and let us know what you think.

We look forward to receiving your feedback.

Thank you!
